pull.title: fuzz: fix stale comments in http_request
pull.body:
Follow-up to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36135#discussion_r4030189935, fixing a false comment flagged in review.

The comment says a completed request is always handed back to a worker. Since #36174 it stays in `m_req` when the send buffer is over MAX_BODY_SIZE.

events.message:
fuzz: fix stale comments in http_request

A completed request is no longer always handed back to a worker; it stays
in m_req when the send buffer is full.

Also drop the pre-existing comment/note about what ReadBody() returned before the libevent
replacement.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Zipkin <pinheadmz@pm.me>

comments.body:
Not sure about all the raw `#id` in code comments. Either the pull request context is important, and it should be a full URL, so that it is easily navigable, or it should just be removed or refer to the (other) code itself.

Same above: How is it relevant that `ReadBody` returned an empty string before 35182? The comments should explain the current code and context and not some irrelevant context or irrelevant history.
Said “incomplete or failed” since this branch could also be reached on a parse error.
